title: John Tenniel's illustrations for Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (1865)
licence: Public domain (published 1865; Tenniel died 1914). Image processing by Standard Ebooks, CC0 1.0.
source: Standard Ebooks edition of Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland (John Tenniel illustrations), fixtures/epub/alice-standard-ebooks.epub, https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/lewis-carroll/alices-adventures-in-wonderland/john-tenniel
notes: Tenniel’s 1865 plates carry no printed captions. `caption` is the entry for the illustration in the source’s List of Illustrations, which quotes the passage it illustrates; `alt` is the source’s alt text. Both are verbatim from the Standard Ebooks edition (CC0).
`chapter` is the chapter the illustration appears in (null for the frontispiece, which shows the trial in chapter 11).
Images are the source’s 2× black-on-transparent PNGs flattened onto white and re-encoded as JPEG; long edge ≤ 2048 px.
Anchors and the Illustration Pack definition are a later task (P1-LAY-06).

images.caption: The King and Queen of Hearts were seated on their throne, with a great crowd assembled about them—all sorts of little birds and beasts, as well as the whole pack of cards.
images.alt: The King and Queen of Hearts are seated side-by-side on thrones looking out at the court. The Knave of Hearts is in the foreground, arms crossed and nose in the air.

images.caption: When the Rabbit actually took a watch out of its waistcoat-pocket, and looked at it, and then hurried on, Alice started to her feet.
images.alt: A white rabbit wearing a waistcoat stands upright consulting a pocket-watch.

images.caption: She came upon a low curtain she had not noticed before, and behind it was a little door about fifteen inches high.
images.alt: Alice pulls back a curtain to reveal a small door. She holds a tiny key in her right hand.

images.caption: Round the neck of the bottle was a paper label, with the words “Drink Me” beautifully printed on it in large letters.
images.alt: Alice stands at a small table, holding a bottle labelled “Drink Me.”

images.caption: “Now I’m opening out like the largest telescope that ever was! Goodbye, feet!”
images.alt: Alice stands with arms raised in surprise, as she grows taller and her neck stretches out.

images.caption: The Rabbit skurried away into the darkness as hard as he could go.
images.alt: Alice kneels in a low corridor, watching a white rabbit hurry away.

images.caption: She was in the pool of tears which she had wept when she was nine feet high.
images.alt: Alice is swept off her feet by a flood of water which reaches over her shoulders.

images.caption: The Mouse was swimming away from her as hard as it could go, and making quite a commotion in the pool as it went.
images.alt: Alice is swimming in a pool watching a mouse as big as herself swim away.

images.caption: They were indeed a queer-looking party that assembled on the bank.
images.alt: A large crowd of creatures stand around listening to a mouse. The creatures include an owl, a dodo, and a crab.

images.caption: They all crowded round her once more, while the Dodo solemnly presented the thimble.
images.alt: Alice accepts a humble handed to her by a dodo who is taller than herself. The dodo leans upon a stick.

images.caption: She tried the effect of lying down with one elbow against the door, and the other arm curled round her head.
images.alt: A gigantic Alice is crammed inside a small room, her arm of the window.

images.caption: She did not get hold of anything, but she heard a little shriek and a fall, and a crash of broken glass.
images.alt: Alice’s giant hand comes down from above. A white rabbit in a waistcoat has fallen back into a cucumber-frame.

images.caption: The first thing she heard was a general chorus of “There goes Bill!”
images.alt: A lizard is being shot upwards out of a smoking chimney.

images.caption: An enormous puppy was looking down at her with large round eyes.
images.alt: A tiny Alice hesitantly proffers a stick to a puppy dog which is far larger than herself.

images.caption: The Caterpillar and Alice looked at each other for some time in silence.
images.alt: Alice peers over the edge of a mushroom as tall as herself to stare at an upright caterpillar smoking a hookah.

images.caption: A young man in rural costume stares at an old fat man who is standing on his head.
images.alt: A young man in rural costume stares at an old fat man who is standing on his head.

images.caption: Yet you turned a back-somersault in at the door.
images.alt: A young man in rural costume backs away from a doorway as an old fat man somersaults through it.

images.caption: Yet you finished the goose, with the bones and the beak.
images.alt: A young man in rural costume lifts the covers from a empty plates and stares at a fat old man sitting by a fireplace.

images.caption: Yet you balanced an eel on the end of your nose.
images.alt: A young man in rural costume stares in amazement at an old fat man who is balancing a wriggling eel on his nose.

images.caption: The Fish-Footman began by producing from under his arm a great letter.
images.alt: A frog dressed as a footman stands in a pillared doorway accepting a huge envelope from a fish also dressed as a footman.

images.caption: The Duchess was sitting on a three-legged stool in the middle, nursing a baby.
images.alt: The interior of a kitchen. A servant stirs a pot on the stove while an ugly woman dressed as a duchess sits nursing a squalling baby.

images.caption: It was neither more nor less than a pig, and she felt that it would be quite absurd for her to carry it further.
images.alt: Alice stands in a garden holding a pig in her arms as though it were a baby.

images.caption: She was a little startled by seeing the Cheshire Cat sitting on a bough of a tree a few yards off.
images.alt: Alice stands with her hands clasped behind her, looking up at a grinning cat on the branch of a tree.

images.caption: This time it vanished quite slowly, beginning with the end of the tail, and ending with the grin.
images.alt: A cat on a tree-branch is fading away, leaving only its grin.

images.caption: The Hatter opened his eyes very wide on hearing this.
images.alt: An outside table is set for tea. Alice sits at one end, looking cross. A hare and a hatter sit with a dormouse between them.

images.caption: Twinkle, twinkle, little bat!
images.alt: A hatter sits at a tea-table, singing. He seems to be elbowing a dormouse in the eye.

images.caption: The last time she saw them, they were trying to put the Dormouse into the teapot.
images.alt: A hare and a hatter are stuffing a dormouse into the top of a teapot.

images.caption: The roses were white, but there were three gardeners busily painting them red.
images.alt: Three playing-cards with heads, arms and legs stand around a rose-tree arguing.

images.caption: The Queen turned crimson with fury, and screamed “Off with her head!”
images.alt: The King and Queen of Hearts, surrounded by courtiers, stand in a garden. The Queen points accusingly at Alice. At right, a servant holds a cushion bearing a large crown.

images.caption: The chief difficulty Alice found at first was in managing her flamingo.
images.alt: Alice stands with one foot on a hedgehog, holding on to a flamingo which stares her in the face.

images.caption: When she got back to the Cheshire Cat, she was surprised to find quite a large crowd collected round it.
images.alt: A large cat’s head floats above a crowd which includes the King and Queen of Hearts.

images.caption: She was exactly the right height to rest her chin upon Alice’s shoulder, and it was an uncomfortably sharp chin.
images.alt: Alice walks side-by-side with an ugly duchess. Alice is holding a flamingo under her arm.

images.caption: They very soon came upon a Gryphon, lying fast asleep in the sun.
images.alt: A gryphon lies on the ground, asleep. It is a creature with the fore-parts of an eagle and the hind-parts of a lion.

images.caption: “When we were little,” the Mock Turtle went on at last, more calmly, “we went to school in the sea.”
images.alt: A gryphon sits on the ground next to Alice. On a rock stands a turtle with the head of a calf, weeping.

images.caption: So they began solemnly dancing round and round Alice, every now and then treading on her toes.
images.alt: A turtle with the head of a calf and a gryphon dance around Alice.

images.caption: Her head was so full of the Lobster Quadrille, that she hardly knew what she was saying.
images.alt: A lobster stands upright before a dressing-table, holding a hair-brush.

images.caption: The White Rabbit blew three blasts on the trumpet.
images.alt: A white rabbit stands upright, dressed in livery patterned with hearts. With one hand he is blowing a small trumpet and holding a scroll in his other hand.

images.caption: “I’m a poor man, your Majesty,” the Hatter began, in a trembling voice.
images.alt: A hatter stands holding a cup of tea in one hand and a sandwich in the other. He is in his stockinged feet, with his shoes cast aside.

images.caption: “I’d rather finish my tea,” said the Hatter, with an anxious look at the Queen.
images.alt: A hatter runs off to the right. He is holding a cup of tea and a sandwich.

images.caption: She jumped up in such a hurry that she tipped over the jury-box with the edge of her skirt.
images.alt: Alice is in the process of standing up, and in doing so, upsetting a jury-box filled with small animals.

images.caption: “Why, there they are!” said the King triumphantly, pointing to the tarts on the table.
images.alt: The King of Hearts is seated on a throne, wearing spectacles. Below him stands the Knave of Hearts and on a table is a plate of tarts.

images.caption: At this the whole pack rose up into the air, and came flying down upon her.
images.alt: Alice is standing, trying to fend off a cloud of playing-cards which swirl up around her. At her feet are many small animals.
